faqs.question: How do I place an order?

faqs.answer: Yes! We provide Cash on Delivery all across Pakistan. You only pay cash to the courier rider when the parcel arrives safely at your doorstep.
faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available across Pakistan?

faqs.answer: Select "JazzCash QR Payment" in the checkout form. You will see our verified Ammi Express QR Code and Till / Account details (0308-2494870). Scan with your JazzCash app, enter the grand total, and upload the screenshot or transaction ID. Your order will be prioritized and verified quickly.
faqs.question: How do I pay using JazzCash QR?

faqs.question: Can I check the parcel before paying?
faqs.answer: Yes, we pack all items in genuine sealed boxes with our 7-Day Checking and Replacement Guarantee. If there is any fault, damage, or discrepancy, our WhatsApp support team (0308-2494870) resolves it immediately.
